tone: Testing environment for belt, utility slot, lantern, and charm mechanics.
setting_lore: A debug dungeon with five rooms testing belt equipment, utility slots, lantern fuel/refuel, torch mechanics, and charm AC bonuses.

key_locations.name: Equipment Prep Room
key_locations.description: Starting room with a workbench. Player has belt, lantern, torch, oil flasks, and charms.

key_locations.name: Dark Hallway
key_locations.description: A long dark corridor for testing light radius penalties when light source is belt-mounted.

key_locations.name: Armoury
key_locations.description: Contains chests with belts and charms to test equipping/upgrading.

key_locations.name: Refueling Station
key_locations.description: Supply cache with oil flasks for testing lantern refueling.

key_locations.name: Testing Grounds
key_locations.description: Combat room with enemies to test charm AC bonus and belt-mounted combat.

narrative_rules: This is a testing environment. Describe events concisely.
Everything is designed to be tested, killed, or collected.
